title: Gold Plus Saver Account: Same-day ACH transfers
summary: This document explains how Gold Plus Saver Account supports same-day ACH transfers, including that the account tier has same-day ACH enabled and that eligible payments submitted within processing windows may settle same day. It covers up to 6 authorized users (roles/approvals), initiation guidelines (recipient/routing verification, submitting early, maintaining collected funds), exceptions/holds (risk checks/unusual patterns and routing to the next window if not qualified), and reconciliation (distinct ledger labels and retaining confirmations with initiator/approver details).
